---
description: Start a change. Grill intent, set up work folder, compute slice.
argument-hint: <slug> [--refactor|--hotfix|--migrate|--remove]
---
<!-- generated by scripts/install.sh. edit .agents/ instead -->
start change: $ARGUMENTS

1. scripts/idd init change $ARGUMENTS → work/changes/<slug>/ from templates.
2. skill grill → intent.md: why, outcome, out of scope, done-when, flag, capability, touched box.
3. specs/<cap>/ empty → greenfield. note in intent.md. skip 4.
4. scripts/idd slice <slug>. box missing from specs → list. ask human: /review-new first, or treat as new.
5. >9 touched box or >6 outcome → propose split. stop.
6. stop. tell human: review intent.md → /change-continue.
